redact.PERSON: Name of the applicant, referees, or any other private individual named in the text
redact.EMAIL: Any email address, including spelled-out forms such as 'name dot x at y dot z'
redact.PHONE: Any phone number, in any format
redact.ADDRESS: Home or postal address (street, lot, village or town line)
redact.ID: National ID or other personal identification number

keep: Employer and institution names, even when they contain a family name
Job titles, duties, dates of employment, qualifications, skills, numbers about the work
Vacancy or document reference numbers
policy.out_of_scope: Photographs, scanned images, non-English text, documents over the token budget: not processed, routed to manual.
